description: Load this session's checkpoint and return a compact brief of its goal, progress, next steps, touched files and recent commands, plus which files changed since it was saved. Call at the start of a session or when the user asks to resume. If this session has no checkpoint but others exist in the project, it returns a list instead: show it to the user, ask which one to resume, and call again with `checkpoint` set to its selector. After loading another session's checkpoint, pass that selector as `resumedFrom` on the next save_session_checkpoint call.

checkpoint.description: Which checkpoint to load, as a selector from list_session_checkpoints: a session id, or 'legacy'. Omit to load this session's own checkpoint.

format.description: brief: compact markdown for resuming (recommended). full: the complete checkpoint JSON.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the client's workspace root or the server's working directory.

session.description: This conversation's session id, as returned by an earlier save. Omit on Claude Code. Not for picking a checkpoint to read: use load_session_checkpoint's checkpoint, then resumedFrom.

name: load_session_checkpoint
title: Load session checkpoint
